```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
```

## Here is a raw list of entries by class:


<!-- read file -->

 
```{r}
df <- read.csv(file="wordCloudRaw.csv")
```

<!-- List terms -->
```{r}
df$value
```

List converted terms


```{r}
df$revised
```

# Count by group, dropping "NA"

```{r}
df |> group_by(class) |> filter(!is.na(revised)) |> tally()
```


```{r}
df |> group_by(class) |> filter(!is.na(revised)) |> 
  group_by(revised) |> tally() |> arrange(desc(n)) |> 
  kable()
```


```{r}
df |> group_by(class) |> filter(!is.na(revised)) |> 
  group_by(revised) |> tally() |> filter(n>1) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y=revised,x=n))+geom_bar(stat='identity')
```
```{r}

df |> group_by(class) |> filter(!is.na(revised)) |> 
  group_by(revised) |> tally() |> filter(n<2) |> 
  kable()
```
